translation.name: Kalam Baybol Buk Gor minim nuk kisin angayak

book.name: Luk
book.title: LUK Jiysis Krays Minim Tep Luk Tikak

content: Binuk Kuŋaynep Aŋgyokek Am Miñmon Keykey Minim Aŋgñiyak

Kisen Jiysis bi ñin jiwiy omiŋal nokom, andikiy omiŋal nokom (72) diy, kuyip bilok omiŋal ak key, omiŋal ak key miñmon okok keykey aŋgyokyiŋg aŋgak, “Nimb nind amiy, minim yip ak aŋgñem, yand kisen niniŋgayn aŋgak.”

Pen kuyip minim bap aŋgak, “Tap woŋg ak kuŋay yimb nep mindip ak pen, biynimb pipaŋg dand wep gok nep kuŋay ma mindpay. Kun ak, bi woŋgday nop nimb anup aŋgniŋ mindem, biynimb tap pipaŋg dand wep gunap sek aŋgek, am pipaŋg dand winiŋgiy.
Nimb pen woŋg ar kun anep ginimimb. Pen siypsiyp ñiluk yand gok nimbip yoksipiyn; kayn ayndik mindpay namb ak,
anpawis, wand, tomb tirup gok sek, dand ma amnimimb. Biynimb kinjeŋnamb okok niŋiy, minim ma aŋgnimimb.
Pen korip bap amjakiy, korip miŋgan amyiŋg, kuyip minim tep won ak aŋgiy aŋgnimimb, ‘Gor nimbip kond mindeŋ.’
Aŋgem, biynimb Gor nup dep rek mindeniŋgambay gok, minim nimbip kun ak diniŋgambay.

“Pen korip kun anep mindiy, tap keñmaŋgiy dap ñiniŋgambay gok, ñimbyiŋg mindenimimb. Chinup tap minek minek ñey ñimbun ak, nambiŋ gip aŋgiy, korip ok korip ok ma ginimimb. Bi woŋg gipay gok pey dipay. Kun ak rek, kuyip minim tep aŋgem niŋniŋgambay rek, nimbip pen keñmaŋgiy ñiniŋgambay.
“Pen miñmon bap amem, nimbip sik aŋgdiy, keñmaŋgiy ñiniŋgiy gok ñiŋnimimb.
Miñmon kun ak, biynimb tap ginimuŋ gok, gem suŋ ayakniŋ, biynimb gok kuyip maŋgiysek aŋg tep giy aŋgnimimb, ‘Kiyŋ yomb biynimb diy kond mindeniŋgamb ak, tomb aŋgin nimbip ak wip aŋgnimimb.’
“Pen miñmon bap amem, nimbip ma sik aŋgdey, lor namb siŋak amiy, ‘Miñmon nimb biy apon silkul dip gok, wiyk nimbip ker yokiy amjipun.
Pen niŋim: Kiyŋ yomb biynimb diy kond mindeniŋgamb ak, tomb aŋgin nimbip ak wip aŋgnimimb.’

“Nimbip aspiyn: kisen kor yomb ñin ak, miñmon Sodom Gomora biynimb tap siy tap timey nep gey gey yin simbok amnak ak, kor giy yiwur sikoy rek diniŋgambay; biynimb minim nimb am aŋgem ma diniŋgambay gok, kor giy yiwur yomb yimb diniŋgambay.
Yiwur Diniŋgambay

“Korasin biynimb gok sek, Betsayda biynimb gok sek tap mageprek ak gen, niŋiy kirpay rek, yiwur yomb yimb diniŋgambay. Pen Taya-Saydon biynimb gok kuyip, tap magep kun ak rek, gunap gen niŋbiyap ak, chech talik yowip gunap yimiy, bisgiy tun diyiŋg diyiŋg mindembiyap.
Kor yomb ñin ak, Taya-Saydon biynimb yiwur sikoy rek diniŋgambay; Korasin biynimb gok sek, Betsayda biynimb gok sek yiwur yomb yimb ak diniŋgambay.
Pen ñin kun ak, Kapaniyam biynimb kunep, semb biyoŋ ma amniŋgambay; pisnep kaw miŋgan yomb ak amniŋgambay aŋgak.”

Jiysis binuk gok kuyip aŋgak, “Biynimb minim nimbip dipay gok, minim nimbip ak mer: minim yip ak dipay. Nimbip ma dipay gok, nimbip mer: yip ma dipay. Pen yip ma dipay ak, yip mer: Biyomb yip yokek winik ak nup ma dipay aŋgak.”
Binuk Kuŋaynep Andkind Wiyak

Pen kisen binuk ñin jiwiy omiŋal nokom, andikiy omiŋal nokom (72) kun gok, miñmon okok taŋgjiwiy apiy, tep gakniŋ Jiysis nup aŋgyak, “Biyomb! Kichekiy malñiluk biynimb ambaŋ ayip gok yimb nip ak aŋgiy, ‘Jiysis mindip rek mis amnim’ aŋgon, apun rek niŋiy ambay aŋgyak.”
Aŋgeyak, kuyip aŋgak, “Yand niŋmindnikniŋ, kichekiy malñiluk nop kiyk Seytan, kasek won anep, añiñak rek diy apyap pikip.
Siyŋ saraw, kondal, maploŋgim, tap okok nimbip miluk niŋiy, timey giniŋgiy rek ma ayip. Nimbip ñinen aspiyn rek, yuk yokem amniŋgambay.
“Pen kichekiy malñiluk gok, apun rek niŋiy ambay aŋgiy, miñmiñ ma ginimimb; Gor Biyomb chin ak, yimb chinup di ayip miñmon nuk biyoŋ aŋgiy, miñmiñ ginimimb aŋgak.”
Jiysis Nop Gor Nup Tep Aŋgak

Won kun siŋak, Gor Kawnan ak Jiysis nup bak ayek, nup tep gakniŋ, Gor nup aŋgniŋiy aŋgak, “Bapiy. Nand Biyomb semb biyoŋ sek, man biy sek kond mindpan ak, gos nak ak key niŋey tep gip ar ak gipan. Chin biynimb yomb gos tipaŋgiy niŋbun apay gok kuyip kirgiy, chin biynimb tep ma mindpun, ñapan sikoy rek mindpun apay gok kuyip diy, kuyip gos tep ñimban ak, nip tep aspiyn aŋgak.”

Kun aŋgiy aŋgak, “Biynimb gunap yip ma niŋbay; Bapiy nep yip niŋimb. Pen Bapiy nup kunep biynimb gunap ma niŋbay; yand nep nup niŋrep gipiyn. Pen Bapiy yip aŋgek, nuk gip rek gipiyn ak mey, biynimb gos tep ñiyn aŋgiy niŋbiyn gok, gos tep ñen, Bapiy nup niŋrep gipay aŋgak.”

Kun aŋgiy, andikiy binuk gok nep kuyip aŋgak, “Gapman biyomb gok sek, Gor minim aŋgep biyomb gok sek kuŋaynep rek, yand gipiyn ak, minim apiyn ak, niŋun aŋgiy kond mindyiŋgipay ak pen; ma niŋyak. Gor nimbip di tep yimb gek mey, niŋsipim aŋgak.”
Bi Samariya Nimb Ak Girep Yimb Gak
Bi low tiysa bap, Jiysis yerip rek aŋgnimuŋ aŋgiy, ap nup aŋgak, “Tiysa. Yand yerer giy, perper mindeniŋgayn?”
Aŋgek, nup aŋgak, “Baybol buk ak tikiy, yerip aŋgyak?”
Aŋgek, bi low tiysa kun ak aŋgak, “Baybol buk riytiym gi niŋbiyn ak aŋgyak:

content.text: ‘Gor Biyomb nak anup wasemb yimb ay, gos timund nak ak, kilis nak ak maŋgiysek nup ker amnimuŋ. Nand key wasemb aypan rek, biynimb gunap kuyip, kunep wasemb aynimin aŋgiy’ tikyak.”

content: Kun aŋgek, Jiysis bi kun anup aŋgak, “Mey yipund giy apan ak. Ar kun ak kisen giy, perper mindeniŋgamban aŋgak.”

Aŋgek, bi low tiysa kun ak, yimb yip ak sikoy giniŋgamb aŋgiy, Jiysis nup tip aŋgniŋiy aŋgak, “Baybol buk tikyak ak, biynimb gunap kuyip wasemb aynimimb aŋgiy tikyak. Kun ak biynimb gunkay kuyip, kun giyaŋ aŋgiy tikyak?”

Aŋgek, Jiysis bi low tiysa ak nup, kesim diy aŋgak, “Bi bap Jerusalem kirgiy, miñmon Jeriykow amniyn aŋgiy, kinjeŋnamb ak amnakniŋ, bi tap siy dep gunap apiy, nup tapin nep pikiy, chech tap nup gok piliŋg dand amniyakniŋ, nuk kinjeŋnamb siŋak kumniŋg kumniŋg gi mindek.
Bi Gor nup simboŋgep bap, lor ar kun ak amiy niŋak; bi kun ak kumniŋg gi mindek. Nuk niŋiy pis anep amnak.
Pen bi Liypay kiñiŋ Gor aŋgniŋep korip kond mindyiŋgip bap, lor ar kun anep amiy niŋak, bi kun ak kumniŋg gi mindek. Niŋiy, kunep pis anep amnak.
Pen bi Jiwda mer, miñmon Samariya nimb bap, kinjeŋ par nokom kun ak nep amiy niŋak; bi kun ak kumniŋg gi mindek. Niŋiy, nup simb niŋiy,
mindek maŋ siŋak amiy, soy nup gok wel gunap ay, wayn ñiŋg gunap ay tiwniŋgak. Tiwniŋgiy, di doŋgiy ar nuk ak ay dand amiy, korip maniy tawiy kinyiŋgipay ak dam ay, kond mind tep yimb gak.
Minek amniŋg giyiŋg, bi korip kond mindyiŋgip kun anup, maniy kind nokom bap ñiy aŋgak, ‘Nand bi kun biy nup direp ginimin. Pen maniy yerip yerip aŋgniŋgamban ak, andkind apiy nip ñiniŋgayn aŋgak.’”
Jiysis kesim kun ak diy, bi low tiysa kun anup aŋgak, “Bi kinjeŋnamb pikayak ak, bi omiŋal nokom pandikiy, bi an nuk key wasemb ayip rek, nup wasemb ayak?”
Aŋgek, bi low tiysa ak aŋgak, “Bi nup simb niŋiy direp gak ak aŋgak.” Aŋgek, Jiysis nup aŋgak, “Niŋind apan. Mey ar kun anep ginimin aŋgak.”
Mata Nup Woŋg Gos Anep Ayak
Pen Jiysis binuk gok yip miñmon bap amjakeyak, biyn miñmon kun ak mindek bap, kuyip poŋind korip nuk ak amnak. Biyn kun ak yimb nuk Mata.
Korip nuk ak, nunay bap mindek. Yimb nuk Mariya. Pañ Mariya kun ak, Jiysis mindek maŋ siŋak ap bisgiy, Jiysis minim aŋgakniŋ, niŋmindek.

Mata nuk keynep tap keñmaŋgiy daŋgiy gi gi, gos kuŋay niŋiy, ap Jiysis nup aŋgak, “Biyomb. Mariya yip kirgek, key nep tap chin gok daŋgiysipiyn ak tep ma gip. Nup aŋgey apek, omiŋal giy tap daŋgiyur aŋgak.”
Aŋgek, Jiysis aŋgak, “Mata. Mata. Nip tap kun gok nep gos ayip!
Ak tap yikop! Mariya minim tep ak diyn aŋgiy, gos ak ayek, ap niŋmindip. Kun ak, yand nup kiriŋg amnoŋ aŋgnim rek, ma ayip aŋgak.”
